newsitem.title: USA: Phillips to explore off South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Phillips to explore off South Africa.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co said Tuesday it heads a group that agreed with the Republic of South Africa and the South Africa National Oil Co to explore 14.5 million acres in the Indian Ocean.

Phillips is operator of the sub-lease with a 40 percent interest. Co-venturers in the agreement are Energy Africa Bredasdorp Pty Ltd, an independent South African exploration and production company; PanCanadian Petroleum Ltd; and Sasol Ltd, with 20 percent each.

Under the initial four-year agreement, Phillips will gather 1,500 kilometers of seismic data and drill at least one exploratory well, the company said, adding it has committed to spend $8 million over the four-year period. The sub-lease may be extended for two additional periods of three years each.

Phillips said it recently completed an evaluation of the sub-lease area -- Block 17/18 -- during which the company reprocessed and interpreted a substantial amount of seismic data and re-evaluated existing geological and borehole data. Phillips explores for and produces oil, natural gas and gas liquids on a worldwide scale.
